span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Acquiring mathematical expertise drives plastic change in ventral visual cortex for formulas and digits, which in turn reorganises responses to other visual categories such as faces
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Expertise redirects attention toward domain-relevant information, which could by itself produce the frontoparietal activation differences
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The commentary's own Neurosynth analysis supports the dissociation independently: regions reported alongside the term numerical are largely separate from those reported alongside language
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The overlap between advanced mathematical reflection and simple calculation is read as evidence that expertise is built on elementary symbolic number circuits rather than separate from them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Expertise may reorganise the ventral visual stream, with gains for formulas and digits accompanied by reduced response to faces
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The commentary's own alternative account: expertise may change where attention goes rather than which systems are recruited, and the design cannot separate the two
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A test is proposed that would separate them - compare mathematicians on mathematics with experts in another field on their own domain
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The commentary bounds its own conclusion: language may still matter for the acquisition of expertise, or via connectivity rather than direct recruitment.
span.note: what this limits: the commentary's own reading of the language result: LANGUAGE MAY HAVE PLAYED A ROLE IN THE INITIAL ACQUISITION OF MATHEMATICAL EXPERTISE OR ... AT THE LEVEL OF FUNCTIONAL CONNECTIVITY WITH LANGUAGE AREAS ... RATHER THAN THROUGH THEIR DIRECT RECRUITMENT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The evidence discussed is correlational and cannot establish that expertise causes the reported plastic changes.
span.note: what this limits: any causal reading of the expertise-related differences: SUCH CORRELATIONAL DATA CANNOT BE USED TO INFER CAUSALITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The commentary's own caution, echoing the original authors: the expertise-related brain differences are correlational and cannot establish causality
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[1] · what this limits: the same scope as limitations[1], and it is an amplification rather than a new objection: AS AMALRIC AND DEHAENE ACKNOWLEDGE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Genetic differences between the groups are as compatible with the data as expertise-driven plasticity
span.note: what this limits: the plasticity interpretation specifically: IT IS EQUALLY PLAUSIBLE THAT GENETIC DIFFERENCES BETWEEN EXPERT MATHEMATICIANS AND NONMATHEMATICIANS AFFECT THE ORGANIZATION OF THE VENTRAL VISUAL STREAM
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The refutation of the language hypothesis is qualified in two ways the data cannot reach
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as limitations[0] - the refutation of the language hypothesis is qualified in two ways these data cannot reach

span.label: Whether the link to elementary number extends to nonsymbolic representations is untested and not implied
span.note: what this limits: the extension to nonsymbolic number: A CONNECTION BETWEEN SYMBOLIC NUMBERS AND MATHEMATICAL EXPERTISE IN THE BRAIN DOES NOT NECESSARILY IMPLY THAT THE SAME IS TRUE FOR NONSYMBOLIC NUMBER PROCESSING

span.label: Whether the reorganisation has behavioural consequences is left as an open question
